settings.headline: BUILT TO KEEP GOING.
settings.subtext: IT STARTS WITH THE DECISION TO MOVE. Performance is not only about speed—it is about showing up, pushing forward, and finding your own pace.

settings.headline: MOVEMENT. CONSISTENCY. PROGRESS.
settings.text: HIIT is a running apparel brand built around movement, consistency, and personal progress. We believe performance is not only about speed. It is about showing up, pushing forward, and finding your own pace. Built for movement, designed for runners.
